question_text: Where does machine learning improve compiler optimization decisions?

ranking.answer_fit_rationale: Targets compiler optimization decisions explicitly, learning heuristics over raw code for heterogeneous device mapping and GPU thread coarsening, with reported gains over hand-crafted-feature models.
ranking.interestingness_rationale: Useful because it isolates the decision-making layer of compilation and demonstrates that representation learning can reduce manual feature engineering for compiler heuristics.
ranking.overall_rationale: Strong second recommendation: it is highly aligned with the question, publicly accessible, and complements Ansor by covering general compiler heuristic learning rather than tensor-program search alone.

title: End-to-End Deep Learning of Optimization Heuristics

venue.reputation_rationale: PACT is a reputable peer-reviewed compiler and architecture conference; the university records list the paper in the 2017 PACT proceedings published by IEEE.
